status_summary: On 2025-03-12 the Acting Assistant Administrator for Enforcement and Compliance Assurance issued a memorandum to regional administrators and regional enforcement staff that requires advance approval or concurrence from the Assistant Administrator for Enforcement or a delegee before certain actions: those that would unduly burden or disrupt energy production or power generation, resolutions of oil and gas methane violations, actions concerning rules under reconsideration, and broader environmental justice considerations. The approval runs to the enforcement office, not the air office, and covers listed categories rather than all regional air enforcement. No requirement for air office approval of regional air enforcement was found. A further memorandum of 2025-12-05 from the same office directs that findings of violation and injunctive terms rest on the best reading of the statute and regulation, requires enforcement-office approval for injunctive relief beyond clear legal requirements, third-party audits or monitoring and certain settlement terms, and has regions elevate ambiguities in applying a rule to headquarters; it too runs to the enforcement office, not the air office.

timeline.event: The Acting Assistant Administrator for Enforcement and Compliance Assurance issued a memorandum, Implementing National Enforcement and Compliance Initiatives Consistently with Executive Orders and Agency Priorities, requiring headquarters enforcement approval or concurrence for specified categories of regional actions.

The Acting Assistant Administrator for Enforcement and Compliance Assurance issued a compliance-first memorandum to headquarters and regional enforcement leadership: findings of violation and injunctive terms are to rest on the best reading of the law; injunctive relief beyond clear legal requirements, third-party audits or monitoring, and mitigation or stipulated-remedy settlements need that office's approval, the latter two before negotiation; and ambiguities in applying a statute or rule are to be elevated to headquarters. It rescinds a 2021 injunctive-relief memorandum and does not mention the Office of Air and Radiation or the 2025-03-12 memorandum.

title: Require air office approval before regional air enforcement actions
